title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 144
description: Ten questions on Psalms 144: the rock who trains hands for war, man like a breath, and the happiness of a people whose God is Yahweh.

questions.text: What does Yahweh, the psalmist's rock, teach his hands and fingers to do?
questions.explanation: He blesses Yahweh, his rock, who teaches his hands to war and his fingers to battle.

questions.text: According to verse 2, who does God subdue under the psalmist?
questions.explanation: He calls God his fortress, high tower, deliverer and shield, who subdues his people under him.

questions.text: What is man like, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: The psalm says man is like a breath, and his days are like a shadow that passes away.

questions.text: What will happen to the mountains when God touches them?
questions.explanation: The psalmist asks God to part his heavens, come down and touch the mountains, and they will smoke.

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask God to throw out and to send out against his foes?
questions.explanation: He prays, "Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them."

questions.text: On what instrument will the psalmist sing a new song to God?
questions.explanation: He says, "I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you."

questions.text: Who does God rescue from the deadly sword?
questions.explanation: God is the one who gives salvation to kings and rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.

questions.text: What are the daughters compared to in verse 12?
questions.explanation: The psalm asks that their daughters be like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

answers.text: Pillars carved to adorn a palace

questions.text: What do the sheep produce in the fields?
questions.explanation: The psalm pictures barns full of provision and sheep that produce thousands and ten thousands in the fields.

questions.text: Who are the happy people in the final verse?
questions.explanation: The psalm ends, "Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is Yahweh."

answers.text: The people with full barns only
The people ruled by a wise king
The people whose God is Yahweh
The people who live in peace with all nations
